comment: Text detector for the browser receipt scanner, from the PP-OCR ONNX conversions. Pinned by revision and SHA-256; regenerate with scripts/fetch-receipt-ocr-models.mjs. Only the detector is listed: this repository's recognisers are unusable (they decode glyphs as the wrong characters and the offset is not constant), so lines are read by TrOCR instead — see docs/receipt-scanning.md.
